mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 declines and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face production and delivery challenges.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO drops and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals a potential deflationary risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between sustained low CPIAUCSL and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% within a month signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and economic activity are expected to rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between joint PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease with positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised upwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
